_comment: NHDPlus HR MapServer/3 query responses, in the documented ArcGIS shape
{features: [{attributes: {...}}]}. Attribute values are the ones observed
in the produced NC dataset (fishing-areas/enrichment.json), including the
no-data sentinels that leaked through as real values: streamorde -9 and
totdasqkm -9999 on 29 coastal reaches. Captured as a fixture so the
parsing can be tested without touching the live USGS service.

coastal_sentinel.comment: locationID 1757 AVALON BEACH / KITTY HAWK BAY — all VAA no-data

named_match.comment: locationID 1550 AMBOY RIVERFRONT PARK / FRENCH BROAD RIVER — the name match must win over the larger-drainage neighbour

unnamed_largest.comment: no GNIS name matches the waterbody — fall back to the largest drainage area

partial_sentinel.comment: a real reach whose slope alone is no-data (-9998) — order/drainage/flow stay

empty.comment: no flowline within the 350 m search radius
